summary: Connect SDG commitments to accountable decisions, indicators and reporting. Explore the five-day course outline and practical learning outcomes.
lede: SDG governance training helps planning, sustainability and programme professionals turn goals into accountable decisions. Participants map decision rights and target ownership, connect budget lines to targets, and build indicator trackers with data-quality checks. They also review policy trade-offs and prepare evidence-backed progress briefs for leadership.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate SDG accountability across policy, planning, budgeting, sustainability reporting and programme oversight. It suits intermediate-level practitioners who need to make target ownership and progress evidence usable in regular decisions.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with governance, policy, sustainability or programme oversight is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Spreadsheet exercises use Excel or an equivalent spreadsheet; bring a laptop with access to a spreadsheet application.
